parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test target files: 'Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift' (package: Artwork) and 'Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift' (package: AppServices). The name collision on 'MockArtworkService' is a local type-alias-object defined within each test file's scope, which is a standard test-fixture pattern. Consolidating these across package boundaries would couple unrelated test targets and violate test isolation. No structural evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor) is present to further motivate action.
